card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

mechanism: A keeps a supporter briefly present to rehearse a difficult announcement until able to tell the children alone.
confusable: Unlike prolonging company indefinitely, A must connect the requested stay to a concrete step toward independent readiness.
comparison: D98-a rehearses one hospital sentence within taxi time; D98-b practises a one-cup routine while facing the empty flat.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
